definitions.explanation: A team game in which players throw a ball to hit opponents, who are out when struck. A fixture of Japanese elementary-school PE classes and recess.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}みにドッジボールをした。
examples.english: We played dodgeball during the lunch break.

examples.japanese: ドッジボールでボールを{当|あ}てられて{外野|がいや}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: I got hit by the ball in dodgeball and had to go to the outfield.

examples.japanese: {体育|たいいく}の{時間|じかん}にクラス{対抗|たいこう}のドッジボール{大会|たいかい}があり、{最後|さいご}まで{残|のこ}った。
examples.english: There was an inter-class dodgeball tournament during PE, and I survived until the end.

notes:
Also written ドッチボール in casual writing. In the Japanese school version, players who are hit move to the {外野|がいや} (outfield) surrounding the opposing court and can return by hitting someone from there.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドッジボールをする: to play dodgeball
- ドッジボール{大会|たいかい}: a dodgeball tournament
- ボールを{当|あ}てる: to hit someone with the ball
- ボールを{避|よ}ける: to dodge the ball

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {球技|きゅうぎ}: ball games — the category term used in PE
- ドッジ{弾平|だんぺい}: a famous dodgeball manga that popularized the sport
